videos.title: Cem Karsan: When the VIX Hits 40, the Tinder Is Packed
videos.description:
What happens after the VIX touches 40 looks encouraging on the chart. The median return is positive and the distribution leans right. The problem is the left side of it. Cem Karsan points out that the times the VIX touched 40 against this much open interest and risk were March 2020 opex and 1987, and in those setups the tinder is packed. You can get a massive tail. If the tail doesn't transpire, the flows underneath are very positive.

videos.title: Everyone Thinks the Bottom Is In. The Options Say One in Three
videos.description:
A 5% up day feels like a bottom, but feeling isn't math. Jermal Chandler takes Mike Wilson's 8,700 target to the 2027 options and prices it. The expected move is about 1,200 points in either direction, which tops out near 8,400, short of the call. Probability of touch on 8,700 comes in at 31%, against roughly 48% on an equivalent move lower, because the skew sits where the fear is. His floor had already broken the day before.
